Source: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1911946
Access: readable in browser on2026-10-06T19:10:50.939Z.

Later request to restore continuous held-delete behavior was closed WONTFIX as intentional protection. This confirms the behavior is deliberate; bulk delete should use explicit multi-selection. Do not generalize this to all repeat keys: navigation has different needs.

Exact source excerpts:
> Let's close, this is intended behavior from bug 1675212. You can always shift/ctrl select a bunch of messages and delete, when you need mass deletion.
